6. Read the following lines from the Arthaśhāstra. “An annual salary of 60 paṇas could be substituted by an āḍhaka of grain per day, enough for four meals…” (One āḍhaka is equal to about 3 kg) What does this indicate about the value of one paṇa? The fine for failing to help a neighbour was 100 paṇas. Compare this with the annual salary. What conclusion can you draw about the human values being encouraged through this?
7. Write and enact a skit to show how people may have persuaded each other to use cowrie shells (or other such items) as the medium of exchange. Reprint 2026-27
